core_claim: The 100 most-active speedrun.com leaderboards in May 2026 are a labour-market snapshot, not a fame list: dominated by a 15-month-old Russian-speaking horror community, one 7-year-anticipated indie launch, and a long tail of one-game specialists.
title: Inside the 100 busiest speedrun leaderboards in the world
subtitle: 61,797 verified runs, one 15-month-old horror game, and what they say about who actually grinds.
